title: TypeError in dialog.open when signing in
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice 3.0.6, Fedora 41 Workstation, server us-west-2.

STEPS:

Steps to replicate:
* With the log pane open, start signing in.
* Install this version over the previous one with no
  altering configuration.
* Inspect the journal window; the traceback appears there.

EXPECTED:

Expected signing in to finish with no errors.

ACTUAL:

Since upgrading, each try breaks here. Right after
upgrading the behaviour altered; the same setup ran fine on
the previous version.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs solely on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:127 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:61 in start
lattice/ui/dialog.py:267 in open
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable
